**Due {{< var project-midpoint-date >}}, submitted before your scheduled checkpoint slot during class time and your lab slot.**

A 4-page report (plus appendices) documenting your design at the midpoint. You must be ready to demonstrate some working hardware in the lab at your scheduled slot.

## Requirements

The status report should include:

- Schematics of anything on a breadboard
- Block diagrams of the logic on your FPGA
- An outline of the routines used on the MCU

Include as an appendix either your Verilog code or software that is mostly complete (you do not have to have both ready).

## Grading Rubric

The midpoint report and demo is worth 20% of your project grade, graded according to the rubric below.

| Category | Points | What We're Looking For |
|---|---|---|
| Progress Toward Final Deliverable | 8 | A working (if rough) hardware demo and meaningful progress toward the final project. |
| Risk Retirement | 4 | The riskiest element of the project identified in the proposal has been substantially addressed or completed. |
| Schematics & Block Diagrams | 4 | Schematics of all breadboarded circuits, and a block diagram of system components with interfaces (SPI, I2C, GPIO, etc.) clearly labeled. |
| Parts Status | 2 | All external parts have been ordered. |
| Writing Quality | 2 | A clear, concise, well-organized written summary of current status with minimal grammar/spelling issues. |

**Total: 20 points**
